verdict.rationale: three.js has its own hosted API reference (per-class pages such as GLTFLoader and OrbitControls under threejs.org/docs) and a separate examples gallery that community users praise. However, the evidence never shows the examples being runnable or editable inside the API reference, and the human doc pages are hash-routed rather than offered as static per-page URLs. missing for 10: explicit evidence that API reference pages embed live or runnable examples, documentation of interactive exploration features, and independent hands-on corroboration of an interactive reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: the three.js examples are good (if a little sloppy in coding style)
